tables.name: Primary Building Material
tables.description: What the fortress is mostly built from.

results.name: Brick
results.description: Man-made blocks, comprised of mud, clay, or sand, mixed with a binding material such as straw, baked hard.

results.name: Timber
results.description: Hewn logs and planks, milled to fit together tightly.

results.name: Stone
results.description: Rough-cut or smoothed and shaped, typically built on and around a timber frame and mortared together.

results.name: Salvage
results.description: Found materials, such as repurposed stone from crumbled ruins, or timbers from wrecked ships.

results.name: Unique Materials
results.description: Roll on the unique building materials table. If your result conflicts with your environment or campaign setting, reroll. If none work, use ‘Salvage’.
